The blue frontage is acknowledged only by a shallow side relationship; there is no legible court, undercut, entry seam, or public void that would satisfy the neighborhood-living active edge invariant. The form is repairable in principle, but not yet program-fit; it needs a carved void or courtyard aligned to access and a cleaner anchor for the dominant mass, ideally while preserving the simple bar gesture.
